{{Top|leg}}
'''Zaloxipine''' was a chemical used by the staff of the [[Valorum Center]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to keep dangerous inmates manageable.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

One of their patients, [[Arla Fett]], was under a five hundred dose when [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Kal Skirata]] unexpectedly rescued her from her cell.<ref name="o66" />
